dogecoin.text: @rashirahaney @SenguptaNishant When Musk was going to appear on SNL a few days ago, the whole world saw that night was going to send dogecoin's value "to the moon" and it kinda did too. Why? Mere influence.

@rashirahaney @SenguptaNishant The mere influence the man has. Dogecoin was created as a joke but one tweet from the man got people around the world investing in it and now (if I'm not wrong) its the third largest crypto currency in terms of market cap.
